main_text.p: fit & inauditæ sævitiæ: Et eandem illam in mediam generis humani partem, qua quæso æquitatis specie tegimus injuriam? Nec intra limites iftos ftatur : Sunt qui abfentem adverfarium in Scholis traducant, funt qui mite fubditumque ingenium, modo ut atrox, modo ut ambitiofum depingant: Nec falsâ perfuafione, quod ignofci poterat, aguntur, fed ambitu gloriolæ: & mulierum hoftes libenter audiunt: Pol de fexu suo bene meriti mares! Denique ingenium fæminis, noftro nitidius eft: & momentorum etiam, quæ rudes craffique negligimus, curiofum: Atqui à minimis illis tota pendet Philofophiæ meffis : conftat enim merentibus in hoc agro colonis, quod femen hîc jaciendum, fi fortè vel levi tantum falfitatis rubigine vitiatum fuerit, præpofterâ fertilitate mox
main_text.notes: Catchword "in" is read from the foot of the last line. Signature "K 3" is read from the foot of the text block. Some letters are faint at the line ends and the number "221" was read as printed. The left-edge fragments belong to the adjacent page and were left out.
